orbital_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_5: GalCop orbital HQ confirms receipt of all four investigations. The fuel evidence and intercepted shipment have bought time, but the defence-grid lead still needs stronger evidence. Choose one next step: place Weiss under surveillance, follow the Kinnaird lead, or request more intelligence from LEXICON. Your choice remains pending until confirmed.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_5a: GalCop orbital HQ ends your assignment because the shipment interception exposed you to local witnesses and Sirius surveillance. The investigation will continue with another commander. Your earlier investigation records remain saved; no further campaign reward is awarded.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_5b: GalCop orbital HQ ends your assignment because the shipment reached Sirius. Your earlier investigation records remain saved; no further campaign reward is awarded.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_1: GalCop orbital HQ has a recent sighting of Pieter Kinnaird's purple Mosquito Sport at Atanon. Ask the orbital station engineering desk about its next destination.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_brief_1: Ask Atanon orbital station engineering about Pieter Kinnaird's purple Mosquito Sport.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_2: Atanon orbital engineering confirms that the purple Mosquito stopped for fuel and injector repairs. Their workshop could not complete the repair. The saved service directory identifies Orlaaror's orbital shipyard as a suitable nearby workshop. The clue is recorded in your journal.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_3alt: The orbital station at [mission_IR_saved_location_1] has no useful recent sighting of Kinnaird. Your existing engineering clue remains in the journal.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_3: Orlaaror orbital shipyard records confirm a purple Mosquito Sport with injector damage, registered under Jacob de Vries. The alias matches Pieter Kinnaird. He paid for an urgent repair and stated that he had a meeting at Laxesori. The repair-log evidence is saved.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_brief_3: Ask the arrivals and security liaison at Laxesori orbital station about Jacob de Vries.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_4a: Laxesori orbital arrivals records confirm that Jacob de Vries recently docked. At your request, the station security liaison checks the recording of the meeting area.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_4b: The station recording identifies Pieter Kinnaird meeting Reinhardt Weiss and handing him a sealed package. Its contents are unknown. Security supplies one authenticated digital record for GalCop. Return it to Vegedius orbital HQ; no passenger or physical package has boarded your ship.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_kinnaird_brief_4: Deliver the protected digital station record to GalCop orbital HQ at Vegedius.
orbital_text_overrides.IR_IBANEZ_5_debrief: GalCop orbital HQ accepts the station evidence linking Weiss and Kinnaird. QuiCo security can now remove Weiss from the defence-grid assignment temporarily. No arrest is ordered. The defence network still needs investigation; GalCop will contact you when a new lead is available.
